name: Mifepristone
expected_effect: strong decrease in maternal competence and stable adhesion
implementation: existing IN_MIFEPRISTONE input; preserve partial/context-dependent response during calibration

name: Anti-SPP1 neutralization
expected_effect: decrease one adhesion route but not necessarily abolish adhesion
implementation: existing IN_ANTI_SPP1; never set E_SPP1_EXPR OFF as a surrogate for antibody treatment

name: LIF or LIFR blockade
evidence: mouse knockout and human cell-model support
implementation: candidate clamp or rate reduction; test epithelial-specific blockade first

name: STAT3 inhibition
implementation: separate epithelial and stromal interventions to preserve stage interpretation

name: Forced PODXL maintenance/overexpression
expected_effect: strong decrease in embryo attachment and penetration
implementation: force ON or increase OFF-to-ON rate; check barrier/viability counter-readouts

name: CD98/SLC3A2 knockdown or blocking
implementation: prefer rate modifier rather than sole hard gate

name: Apical CDH1 blockade/knockdown
implementation: do not interpret as global lateral junction disruption unless experiment does so

name: ANXA2 knockdown or RHOA/actin interference
implementation: medium-priority rate modifier with cytotoxicity/morphology counter-screen

name: PCSK5/PC6 inhibition
expected_effect: retain DAG1 barrier and reduce attachment
implementation: measure alpha-DG-N cleavage product to validate mechanism

name: MUC1 abundance/glycosylation perturbation
expected_effect: can decrease or increase adhesion depending on glycoform
implementation: never use a single MUC1 knockout rule; measure glycoform and surface density

name: SPP1 knockdown
evidence: human epithelial association and stromal mechanistic evidence
expected_effect: decreased adhesion support and/or decidual quality

name: TAZ/WWTR1 inhibition
expected_effect: defective ECM remodeling and reduced stabilization
implementation: later extension; measure collagen architecture and mechanics

name: Excess ER stress (for example thapsigargin)
expected_effect: prevent normal softening and impair spheroid adhesion/expansion
implementation: external perturbation input with toxicity controls

name: Increase ECM stiffness
expected_effect: reduce mechanical permissiveness; effect size requires calibration
implementation: prefer continuous PhysiBoSS field or rate scaling over permanent Boolean clamp

name: HB-EGF/EGFR-family blockade
evidence: human receptive-phase expression and integrin regulation
implementation: test as a secondary, non-hard-gate perturbation

name: alphaVbeta3/alphaVbeta5 blockade
implementation: clarify maternal versus embryo receptor target in the actual reagent/assay

name: WNT5A/7A depletion or sFRP2
implementation: external embryo-competence modifier, not maternal intracellular core logic

name: Temperature, pH or oxygen excursion
evidence: NAM/QC context; little direct adhesion-specific causal evidence in this inventory
expected_effect: unknown direction until measured in ADOC
implementation: record as boundary/QC variables; do not invent Boolean edges
